depiction_rules.notes: Protective-canopy remains the D038 mode above Vasudeva and infant Krishna. For source-grounded Narayaneeyam D008 scenes 6–8, use cosmic-reclining-couch: one large coherent serpent body forms a stable couch beneath Narayana, with an odd-numbered symmetrical hood fan protecting him from above. This is a chapter-specific iconographic mode, not an aggressive or predatory posture.

visual_bible.body: large ivory-white serpent body with restrained deep-blue patterning
visual_bible.hoods: an odd-numbered fan of many symmetrical cobra hoods, centered over the child
visual_bible.jewels: small warm gemstones on the hoods casting gentle path-light
visual_bible.movement: smooth protective arc through storm and river spray
visual_bible.cosmic_reclining_couch: One continuous ivory-white serpent body with restrained deep-blue patterning coils into a stable low couch beneath Narayana; the upper body rises naturally into an odd-numbered symmetrical hood canopy above him. Every coil and hood remains visibly connected to the same serpent; calm, protective, and reverent.

never: do not obscure the face of Narayana
no detached coils or disconnected hood cluster
note: Use D038 S010 for protective-canopy story placement only. D008 scenes 6–8 require the distinct source-grounded cosmic-reclining-couch mode described above; generate an original temple-mural interpretation.
